nodes.label: Invasive species impact

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What do Wenger et al. (2013) describe regarding ecosystem disturbing alien plant species?
nodes.answer: They describe model uncertainty for ecosystem disturbing alien plant species using environmental variables and species occurrence data.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_001
nodes.label: Regulation
nodes.question: How does the Marine Strategy Framework Directive relate to invasive species?
nodes.answer: The Marine Strategy Framework Directive includes a dedicated Descriptor (D2) that EU members must consider when evaluating Good Environmental Status (GES) concerning the hazards of non-indigenous species (NIS) proliferation and invasive species.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why are biological invasions considered a significant threat?
nodes.answer: Experts and international policies recognize biological invasions as one of the significant threats to global marine biodiversity.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What types of analyses were conducted in relation to marine invasion ecology in the Madeira Archipelago?
nodes.answer: Experiments and risk analyses were conducted to test various aspects of marine invasion ecology, such as invasibility and correlation to climate change and metal pollution.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_004
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Why is the risk of local dispersal of NIS concerning?
nodes.answer: The risk is concerning because it remains poorly studied and includes potentially invasive species like Rugulopteryx okamurae and Cronius ruber.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_005
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is suggested by the findings of the studies regarding biotic resistance against NIS invasion?
nodes.answer: The findings suggest some degree of enhanced biotic resistance against NIS invasion in local MPA communities.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_006
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What did recent works investigate about local NIS proliferation?
nodes.answer: Recent works focused on local NIS proliferation and possible trophic control mechanisms.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_007
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What implications do seaweed regressions have on ecosystems?
nodes.answer: Seaweed regressions affect not only the species themselves but also the ecosystems they are part of and their ability to provide ecosystem services.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_008
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How did alien species introduction affect the marine ecosystem?
nodes.answer: The introduction of alien species changed species diversity and caused massive mortality of marine organisms.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Marine biodiversity|Invasive species impact_qna_009
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What role do invasive species play in ecosystem dynamics according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Invasive species can exacerbate biotic pressures by outcompeting native species or altering food web dynamics.
